title: Audit how a passage was assembled
steps: Open a documented case from the 28-case queue.
Show source/extraction and before/proposed-after boundaries or How this passage was built.
Record which parser proposal and case were shown; preserve unresolved status where present.
permitted_claim: The transformation from source to evidence can itself be inspected.
does_not_establish: These are selected known outliers, not a random sample or corpus-wide error-rate estimate.
fallback: Show the pinned source review document if the live viewer is unavailable; do not imply a new repair was made.
classification: existing transformation review; parked proposal, not adopted repair

declared.publication_boundary: This identity is authoritative only when the Site candidate was assembled from a clean checkout of this commit and promoted without rebuild.

actions.action: wait for verified PDF rendering, not just loaded source bytes
